Maybe some low-priority hunting to ensure no other users had issues, but likely not needed if it was just new vendor. Suggest a process change: when alert involves first-seen domain from Finance/HR/etc., Tier 1 should do a 15-minute business context check before recommending isolation.
4. Verification steps already occurred (cross-checking with Finance and TI).
